findings.description: The function accepts a file path as a string and opens it directly.
The `query` parameter is passed directly to `std::regex`, which can throw exceptions if the regex is invalid.
On file open failure, the code prints an error and calls `exit(EXIT_FAILURE)`. This is abrupt and not exception-safe.
Printing the full file path in error messages may leak sensitive information.
There is no limit on the size of the file being read, which could lead to resource exhaustion.
